mapper.delete: /* saleson.shop.disposable.TempEncDataMapper.deleteTempData 임시 암호화 정보 삭제 */ DELETE G_TEMP_ENC_DATA WHERE 1=1 AND REG_DT < ADDDATE(SYS_DATETIME, INTERVAL -1 MINUTE)
mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.disposable.TempEncDataMapper.selectTempData 임시 암호화 정보 조회 */ SELECT DATA_ID , ENC_DATA AS ENC_DATA , REG_DT FROM G_TEMP_ENC_DATA WHERE 1=1 AND REG_DT >= ADDDATE(SYS_DATETIME, INTERVAL -1 MINUTE) AND DATA_ID = #{dataId}
